full_judgment: 2. The petitioner, Chairman of No. 11 Cheora Union Parishad, P.S. Chowddagram, Dist. Comilla, stating, inter alia, challenged the legality of the Gazette Notification dated 12.10.96 showing delimitation of the wards of the Parishad into 9 wards for electing ward members on the ground that Section 20 of the Union Parishad Ordinance 1983 provides that. wards can be delimited taking into consideration territorial unity, distribution of population and administrative convenience but the Delimitation Officer did not follow the mandate of Section 20 and included Haldermura Mouza, a village stands far Off from ward No. 3, in ward No. 3. The petitioner filed objection against such inclusion and that in spite of the objection the Thana Nirbahi Officer finally published the Gazette Notification without giving any hearing to the petitioner and the District Election Officer-1, Comilla declared the election schedule of the said Union Parishad on 24.11.1998 on the basis of Gazette Notification. The petitioner obtained a Rule Nisi which was resisted by the added respondent No. 5 by filing affidavit-in-opposition stating that petitioner, who was not a resident of Haldermura and had no locus standi to file the writ petition and it was not maintainable.
